title: Calling `Curve::withdraw` will likely result in users losing ETH
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as users can lose ETH value  **Likelihood:** High, as all >75 Curve pools that have ETH are problematic  ## Description  The `Curve::withdraw` method removes liquidity from a pool to burn LP tokens and receive the underlying assets, after which a user can sweep them to his wallet. The problem with this is that some pools use ETH as an underlying asset and the `remove_liquidity` method will send back ETH to the caller.
